name: Status: Abandoned :ghost:
description: For whatever reason, this issue has been abandoned. Should probably be triaged into a new category.

name: Status: Accepted :accept:
description: This has been accepted for some kind of work to occur (e.g. writing code / merging / release).

name: Status: Blocked :no_entry:
description: Indicates a request should not be merged yet because it is blocked by an external entity.

name: Status: Completed :tada:
description: This is done (though may require further work, e.g. merging / acceptance for release)

name: Status: In Progress :hourglass_flowing_sand:
description: This is *actively* being worked on (not just in someone's todo list).

name: Status: On Hold :hand:
description: Not being worked on actively for whatever reason (giving a reason is a good thing to do).

name: Status: Review Needed :microscope:
description: No one has looked at this yet.

name: Status: Revision Needed :repeat:
description: Someone has reviewed this and it needs to be updated. Reviewers comments are sufficient to update.

name: Status: Needs Discussion :speech_balloon:
description: Someone has reviewed this and a discussion is necessary to get back on track. Can be instigated by anyone involved.
